messages:
sanjay: Postmortem is up — root cause was a control-plane blip at the cloud provider that caused token refresh storms. That hit model-registry auth and bubbled into user-facing errors. We need concrete follow-ups for retry/backoff, runbook coverage, monitoring, and vendor escalation.

mira: Read it. Agree we need owners. Also spotted gaps in token TTL visibility — we had no alert.

dan: I can own client retry/backoff tuning + a quick compatibility test matrix. Will draft a PR for exponential jitter + cap retries.

lisa: I will own runbook updates and add a verified fallback path in the prod runbook. Also adding a chaos scenario for auth failures to our weekly test set.

julie: Ops note — opened vendor ticket CP-478 with provider. Asked for timeline and interim mitigations. I’ll escalate if we don’t get an ETA.

eng-oncall-bot: Deploy bot: planned canary rollout of retry/backoff changes scheduled 2026-03-26T03:00:00Z. Notify #eng-oncall on start.

sanjay: Action tracker proposal (owners + target dates): dan - client backoff PR (2026-03-24), lisa - runbook + chaos test (2026-03-27), mira - monitoring & alerts (2026-03-25), julie - vendor escalation & SLA confirmation (2026-03-23). I’ll file these into the incident follow-up board.

mira: Monitoring specifics: add an alert when token_refresh_failure_rate > 0.5% for 5m and a dashboard for token TTL distribution by service. Also add a synthetic that exercises registry auth every 2m.

dan: Snippet I'll include in the PR for reference:
```
registry_client.backoff = ExponentialBackoff(base_seconds=0.5, max_seconds=8, jitter=True)
registry_client.max_retries = 5
registry_client.retry_on = [503, 502, 504, ConnectionError]
```

lisa: Chaos test outline: simulate intermittent 5xx from control-plane auth endpoint for 3m windows, validate circuit-breakers and fallback path, assert no token leak. I’ll add a ticket in chaos repo.

julie: Vendor update: provider acknowledged "control plane flapping" and assigned an incident; they committed to an RCA by 2026-03-26. Logged contact at our TAM level.

security-bot: Security reminder — rotate short-lived service tokens used by CI and the model-registry ingestion flow as a precaution. Recommend rotation window: 2026-03-24.

sanjay: Recurrence prevention: create a monthly analytics ticket to correlate auth-related vendor incidents with deploy windows and model-registry config changes. Will create in JIRA under INF-ops.

mira: Can we set a short sync next Mon 10:30am PST to confirm PRs/alerts? :calendar:

dan: +1

lisa: +1

julie: +1

sanjay: Final: please add links to PRs/tickets in the incident follow-up doc. Once PR and runbook are merged and chaos test passes, I’ll mark follow-ups resolved. Thanks everyone. :+1:
